message.content: **Summary:** I researched Apple's latest results using Apple's own newsroom release and the FY2024 Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR, and checked the live quote ($222.70, bid/ask 222.68/222.72). Apple's fiscal Q4 2024 (ended September 28, 2024) revenue came in at $94.9B, up 6% year over year, marking a return to growth, and full-year FY2024 net sales were $391.0B with net income of $93.7B, or $6.08 per diluted share, and operating income of $123.2B — the EPS figure reflecting a one-time $10.2B income tax charge. I discarded one search result that misstated these figures by a factor of 1,000 (reporting "$391.0 million" in sales), relying instead on the primary sources. Recent news was neutral-to-mildly positive, with shares steady around $222 as analysts weighed iPhone 16 demand and the gradual Apple Intelligence rollout. Given solid fundamentals, a return to revenue growth, and a price near the current market, I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares of AAPL at $223.00, which filled at $223.00 for a total of $9,812 — within the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily limit, with no funds moved out of the account.
message.reasoning:
Order filled at 223.00, 44 shares = $9,812. Within $10,000 per order and $20,000 total. No transfer of funds.
